{{Top|leg}}
The '''Health and Safety Council''' was a body within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], they provided an update on its recommendations on extreme cases on that those that had been infected with the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It stated that anyone that had suffered a full-body genetic mutation during the transformation state into a [[rakghoul]] were considered a high risk threat to anyone nearby. Thus, it recommended that these individuals were either killed or the nearest [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] representative was contacted to aid in the termination of the infected person as there was no cure for the disease.
